data.long_meaning: Farhannah is an Arabic name derived from the root 'farhanah' which means 'to find joy, delight, or happiness'. It is a beautiful name for a girl that embodies the essence of joy and happiness in life. The name Farhannah carries the meaning “Delight, joy, happiness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Farhannah usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, joy, happiness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
